title: Diagnosing Vision Language Models’ Perception by Leveraging Human Methods for Color Vision Deficiencies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Large-scale Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) using Ishihara Test plates by prompting them to simulate different color vision conditions (normal vision versus Color Vision Deficiencies like Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia) and measuring digit generation accuracy, model confidence (per-token perplexity), and internal representations (layer-wise LogitLens probing).
